verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is a government e-services portal for foreigner registration, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that loads external tool servers is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only front-door HTTP probes and shows no MCP client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
